reports.verdict: Shopify held 32% revenue growth while operating profit rose 66%, and guided to a similar low-thirties pace for next quarter.

takeaways.label: Profits growing much faster
takeaways.text: Operating income jumped 66% to $568 million and free cash flow margin reached 22%, up from 18% a year ago, as revenue grew 32% to $3.74 billion.

takeaways.label: Growth cooled slightly
takeaways.text: Revenue growth slowed from 34% last quarter to 32%. Total sales on the platform grew 29% to $119 billion. Next quarter is guided to low-thirties growth.

takeaways.label: Gross profit lags revenue
takeaways.text: Gross profit grew 28%, slower than revenue, and Q4 gross profit is guided to high-twenties growth. Payments-driven merchant revenue (up 35%) is growing faster than the higher-margin subscription revenue (up 20%).

takeaways.label: Big buyback, lower loan losses
takeaways.text: Shopify repurchased $562 million of its own stock this quarter, versus none a year ago. Transaction and loan losses fell to $120 million from $148 million.

reports.verdict: AMD's AI data center business nearly doubled and the fourth-quarter forecast is about $17 billion, but profit margin stays flat near 55%.

takeaways.label: Big fourth-quarter jump
takeaways.text: AMD guided fourth-quarter revenue to about $17 billion, up roughly 66% from a year earlier and far above the $13.4 billion just reported, as Helios AI racks ramp.

takeaways.label: Data center nearly doubles
takeaways.text: Data center sales rose 97% to $8.5 billion and drove revenue to $13.4 billion, up 45%. Revenue topped the high end of AMD's own guidance.

takeaways.label: Margins not expanding
takeaways.text: Gross margin was 56% and is guided to about 55%, a slight dip. The revenue surge is not yet bringing richer profitability.

takeaways.label: Cash flow and gaming weak
takeaways.text: Free cash flow fell to $554M from $1.56B last quarter. Gaming sales dropped 40% to $773M, hurting an otherwise strong quarter.

reports.verdict: Chemicals growth and lower interest costs lifted profit, but Print, the biggest business, shrank and its profit nearly vanished.

takeaways.label: Print profit nearly gone
takeaways.text: Print revenue fell 7% to $165 million, and its operating profit dropped to $1 million from $8 million. Higher aluminum costs and lower volumes were the main causes.

takeaways.label: Chemicals carrying growth
takeaways.text: Advanced Materials & Chemicals revenue rose 21% to $99 million and its operating profit rose to $21 million from $16 million. It now earns far more than Print.

takeaways.label: Profit boost is mostly debt
takeaways.text: Net income rose to $21 million from $13 million, largely because interest expense fell to $3 million from $18 million after $101 million of term loans were repaid. Operating EBITDA rose only $2 million.

takeaways.label: Cash rebuilt
takeaways.text: Cash rose $27 million to $317 million in the quarter, though it is still $20 million below year-end. Year-to-date operating cash flow is break-even, and inventory is up $44 million.

reports.verdict: Teva raised 2026 revenue and brand-drug targets again on fast growth in Austedo, Ajovy and Uzedy, though total sales fell 2%.

takeaways.label: Brands carry the raise
takeaways.text: Austedo sales rose 21% to $751M, Ajovy 61% to $269M and Uzedy 96% to $85M. The 2026 Austedo outlook went up to $2.55–2.65B from $2.45–2.60B.

takeaways.label: Guidance lifted, profit target flat
takeaways.text: 2026 revenue outlook rose to $16.7–17.0B from $16.5–16.85B. Adjusted EPS stays $1.92–2.11, and the operating income range's top end was trimmed to $3.9B from $4.0B.

takeaways.label: Generics still shrinking
takeaways.text: Total revenue was $4.4B, down 2%, mainly from lower generic sales led by lenalidomide (a cancer drug). Gross margin improved to 55.5% from 51.4%.

takeaways.label: Heavy debt remains
takeaways.text: Debt was $16.7B at quarter-end, with about $4.9B refinanced in the quarter. Free cash flow was $495M and the full-year target edged up to $2.1–2.4B.

reports.verdict: Pfizer raised its 2026 revenue and profit outlook as newer cancer and heart drugs grew fast, though COVID products keep shrinking.

takeaways.label: Guidance raised
takeaways.text: Full-year revenue outlook rises $1.5B at the midpoint to $62-64B. Adjusted EPS guidance moves to $2.95-$3.05 from $2.80-$3.00, even after a roughly $0.10 licensing charge.

takeaways.label: Flat quarter, strong core
takeaways.text: Revenue of $16.6B was flat and adjusted EPS held at $0.87, but sales excluding COVID products grew 7%, and newer and acquired products grew 32%.

takeaways.label: Eliquis and cancer drive growth
takeaways.text: Eliquis sales rose 25% (lower rebates helped), and the cancer drug Padcev rose 55%. COVID treatment Paxlovid fell 63%, the COVID vaccine fell 29%, and the Prevnar vaccine fell 10%.

takeaways.label: Spending on pipeline rises
takeaways.text: R&D spending jumped 18%, mainly for cancer and obesity drugs. R&D guidance rose to $10.8-11.8B. A new CFO, Cecile Guegan, started Nov. 1; no share buybacks are planned this year.

reports.verdict: Refining profits hit another record on war-inflated margins, and management expects them to stay high through mid-2027 while it sells two refineries for cash.

takeaways.label: Record margins again
takeaways.text: Profit per barrel refined jumped to $45.70 from $17.60 a year ago. Adjusted earnings were $26.93 a share, above the roughly $24.5 analysts expected.

takeaways.label: Margins seen lasting
takeaways.text: Management expects elevated margins through at least mid-2027, citing about 10 million barrels a day of global refining capacity offline, and says it has seen no demand destruction.

takeaways.label: Selling two refineries
takeaways.text: Marathon is selling its St. Paul Park and Mandan refineries to CVR Energy for $4.2 billion, with $3.45 billion going to Marathon. Proceeds go mainly to the Gulf Coast.

takeaways.label: Heavy cash return
takeaways.text: Marathon returned $3.3 billion in the quarter, raised its dividend 10% and added a $5 billion buyback authorization. It holds $13.6 billion in cash.

reports.verdict: Palantir's growth is still accelerating, with US business customers now bigger than the US government, but new business contracts are getting smaller and shorter.

takeaways.label: Blowout quarter, raised outlook
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 96% to $2.31B against roughly $2.18B expected. Full-year revenue guidance rose to about $8.53B, with Q4 guided to about $2.65B.

takeaways.label: Business customers overtake government
takeaways.text: US commercial revenue grew 148% to $984M, passing US government revenue ($953M) for the first time. Full-year US commercial guidance is now above $3.56B.

takeaways.label: Bookings and contract length lag
takeaways.text: US commercial new-contract value was $1.46B, down from a record $2.13B last quarter. Management says deals now start shorter and expand later, with duration and size expected to grow.

takeaways.label: Profits remain extreme
takeaways.text: Adjusted operating margin was 62% and free cash flow was $1.22B. Management says the AI-driven 'Sovereign AI' demand trend is only about a quarter old, so durability is unproven.

reports.verdict: Record quarter, but Apple guided December gross margin down to 45%–46% as memory costs climb, and gave no outlook past that.

takeaways.label: Margins squeezed by memory
takeaways.text: December-quarter gross margin is guided to 45%–46%, below the 47.9% just reported (about 1 point of which came from tariff refunds) and below the 46.3% analysts expected. Memory prices are still rising.

takeaways.label: Growth slowing
takeaways.text: December-quarter revenue is guided up 7%–10%, down from 12% this quarter. Services is guided up 8%–9%. Mac and iPad supply stays limited by memory availability.

takeaways.label: AI spending climbing
takeaways.text: Operating expenses are expected to rise 11%–13% next quarter on AI investment. R&D already jumped about 32% to $11.7 billion in the September quarter.

takeaways.label: Strong quarter and year
takeaways.text: Revenue was $114.5 billion (up 12%) and EPS $2.10, both September-quarter records. iPhone grew 17% to $57.6 billion and Greater China grew 21%. Full-year revenue hit $479 billion.

reports.verdict: Refining windfall and a $20 billion 2027 buyback plan lifted shares.

reasons.label: Big refining rebound
reasons.text: Fuel-making profit more than doubled to $9.1 billion from $4.1 billion last quarter.

reasons.label: Huge 2027 buyback
reasons.text: Plans $20 billion of share repurchases in 2027, after $5.1 billion bought this quarter.

reasons.label: Strong cash, less debt
reasons.text: Free cash flow was $19.1 billion, and net debt fell by nearly $11 billion this year.

reports.verdict: Refining-driven profit beat expectations, lifting shares modestly despite lower production and oil prices.

reasons.label: Refining profits surged
reasons.text: Fuel margins pushed refining earnings to $4.9 billion from $1.1 billion a year earlier.

reasons.label: Beat on estimates
reasons.text: Adjusted EPS of $5.28 topped the roughly $4.89 analyst average.

reasons.label: Cash and debt gains
reasons.text: Free cash flow near $14.2 billion; net debt fell to $20.7 billion from $34.5 billion.

reports.verdict: Revenue beat estimates and AbbVie raised its outlook again, lifting the stock modestly.

reasons.label: Outlook raised again
reasons.text: 2026 profit guidance lifted to $13.95–$13.99 from $13.76–$13.96, and the dividend rises 5.2%.

reasons.label: Revenue beat estimates
reasons.text: Sales of $17.4B (up 10.3%) topped the roughly $17.3B analysts expected.

reasons.label: Immunology drugs surging
reasons.text: Skyrizi grew 22.7% and Rinvoq 23.9%, more than offsetting Humira's 31% decline.
